# Upload a blob

## When to use this guide

You have a `Uint8Array`, a Node `Buffer`, or a `ReadableStream` and want it
persisted in the CoreLink CAS. The SDK computes the BLAKE3 digest unless you
supply one explicitly.

## Prerequisites

- Authentication configured ([01-authenticate](./01-authenticate.mdx)).

## Minimal example

```typescript
import { CoreLinkClient } from "@corelink/client";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

const client = new CoreLinkClient({ tenantId: "acme-corp" });
const data = await readFile("./build/output.tar");
const digest = await client.put(data);
console.log("stored:", digest);
await client.close();
```

`digest` is the 64-character BLAKE3 hex string.

## Streaming upload (large blobs)

```typescript
import { createReadStream } from "node:fs";

async function uploadLarge(path: string): Promise<string> {
  const stream = createReadStream(path, { highWaterMark: 4 * 1024 * 1024 });
  return client.putStream(stream);
}
```

In a browser the same API accepts a `ReadableStream<Uint8Array>` (e.g. the
body of a `Response`).

## Idempotency

`put` deduplicates server-side; two uploads of identical bytes resolve to
the same digest without double-billing.

## TypeScript types

The package ships full `.d.ts` declarations:

```typescript
import type { BlobDigest, TenantId, PutOptions } from "@corelink/client";

const opts: PutOptions = { expectedDigest: "..." satisfies BlobDigest };
```

## Errors

| Class | Cause | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `AuthError` | PAT missing or revoked | [01-authenticate](./01-authenticate.mdx) |
| `QuotaError` | Tenant over quota | [troubleshooting](./07-troubleshooting.mdx) |
| `DigestMismatchError` | `expectedDigest` wrong | Recompute |
